notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least one artifact and/or enchantment.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Dockside Extortionist to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least one Treasure artifact token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If opponents control two or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.
